model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates the “effect” values for six different language families across five different models: mBERT-L2, XLM-L2, mBERT-R2, XLM-R2, mBERT-B2, and XLM-B2. The horizontal axis represents language family, with categories labeled “IE-Baltic”, “IE-Germanic”, “IE-Indic”, “IE-Romance”, “IE-Slavic”, “IE-other”, “Isolate”, “Semitic”, and “Uralic”, presented in that order. The vertical axis is labeled “effect” and displays a linear scale ranging from 0 to 30, with tick marks at intervals of 5. For each language family, there are six bars representing the effect value for each of the six models, with mBERT-L2 represented by a dark green bar, XLM-L2 by a light green bar, mBERT-R2 by a dark red bar, XLM-R2 by a light red bar, mBERT-B2 by a dark blue bar, and XLM-B2 by a light blue bar. Each bar also includes an error bar extending vertically from its top. The bars are grouped by language family, and within each group, the models are consistently ordered as described above. The shortest bars are generally found for the “Isolate” language family, with values around 1-3 for most models, while the tallest bars are generally found for the “IE-Germanic” language family, with values reaching up to approximately 25 for some models. No bars are visually emphasized through shading, bolding, outlining, or annotation.
